item.title: Preps of the week: MCAL crowns champions in soccer, basketball
item.description: All four MCAL titles in soccer and basketball were handed out in roughly a 24-hour period spanning Friday and Saturday nights. Four different high schools took home pennants -- Archie Williams in boys soccer, Branson in girls soccer, Marin Catholic in boys basketball, and Redwood in girls basketball.
